title: Restricted Fourier weight above a degree threshold
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $k$ be a natural number, let $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and fix a sign assignment $z$ on the indices outside $J$. Define the restricted Fourier weight at degrees at least $k$ to be $\sum_{S\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)}\mathbf{1}_{\{k\le |S|\}}\,\widehat f_{J,z}(S)^2$, where $\widehat f_{J,z}(S)$ denotes the ambient restriction Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $J,S,z$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function f on the n-dimensional sign cube
sign assignment z on indices outside J
caveat: The supplied context does not define the ambient restriction Fourier coefficient, so the coefficient is named but its construction cannot be specified.
